title: Production admission candidate for external Ribasim-owned surface-water head and signed SWAP exchange
purpose: Move only the bounded SW-RIB-SWM01 research outcome needed for a production-facing external-surface-water profile into a fresh canonical-based work unit.

qualify positive drainage, negative infiltration, missing external head, fixed-weir owner conflict, rollback and exactly-once mass booking
preserve every pre-existing drainage response variant unchanged
excluded: Ribasim process launch or network construction
canonical production admission until independent qualification passes

commit once with hard mass closure
fail before physical solve and preserve committed state
fail before physical solve and preserve committed state

pass_meaning: The canonical runtime has a bounded fail-closed seam for externally owned surface-water heads and signed SWAP exchange. This does not yet admit the full SWAP5+Ribasim application profile.
